name: What should I look for in a window installation contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a window installation contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a window installation contractor, prioritize experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Look for contractors with a strong local reputation, positive customer reviews, and a portfolio of past projects. Ensure they offer clear communication, provide detailed written estimates, and stand behind their work with warranties. Asking for references and verifying credentials can help ensure a reliable choice for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for an experienced, licensed, and insured contractor with positive reviews, clear communication, detailed estimates, and strong warranties.
